difficulty_reason: Riemann–Roch gives a unique quadric and a cubic outside its multiples; the author then compares the Hilbert polynomial with that of the complete intersection to identify the closed subschemes.
source_caveats: The selected claim is the forward direction for the canonically embedded curve explicitly introduced in §19.8. The converse uses Exercise 19.8.A. The very-ampleness criterion for the canonical bundle is a separate Exercise 19.7.A.
